---
name: test-report
description: Make the Word (docx) test report / evidence document with environment, login, steps and screenshots. Use when the user asks for a report, docx, Word document or evidence file.
argument-hint: '[test ids]'
---
Run `lct report [ids]` (no id = last test, `--all` = every test case, `--hide-password` hides the password). Reply with only the line it prints. Never write or edit the report yourself.
